head: b002e9f0cb8a20a8941eccc85be4ebd8fb79d70f
label: 6 × 16 · overlapping setup

metrics.resourceSummary: Nine separate runners. Select a job in the trace for its sampled peak CPU/memory; no single-machine percentage is meaningful for the whole workflow.

context: Nine jobs; six × sixteen browser workers. Run fr1lf3l0rs; commit b002e9f0c.
findings: The new scheduling worked: seven consumers prepared before readiness; teardown installed during tests and cleaned only after every consumer stopped. All 88 active browser cases began within 4.9s; peak simultaneous attempts was 87. Longest browser reporter interval: 73.7s; OS Vitest: 144.1s. The run is red: Docs review timed out clicking Add document comment (outside its allowed quarantine pattern), plus the restored workflow exposed a missing workflow-scope telemetry option. Four other browser tests passed on retry. One deliberate monthly sentinel outcome is separate. Cleanup succeeded and all six blob reports were merged. The telemetry scope bug is fixed in the report commit, with regression tests and a successful dry-run replay of all 17 captured artifacts. No test, timeout or quarantine was changed.
